'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[2021 Afghanistan attacks]]
***[[2021 Puli Alam bombing]]
****A [[suicide bombing|suicide]] [[car bomb]]ing kills 30 people and wounds 91 others in [[Puli Alam]], [[Logar Province|Logar]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-56949830 (BBC)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[Ituri conflict]]
***[[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|President]] [[Félix Tshisekedi]] declares a "state of siege" in the provinces of [[Ituri Province|Ituri]] and [[North Kivu]] due to a spate of violence from armed groups in those areas. [https://www.news24.com/news24/africa/news/dr-congo-announces-state-of-siege-in-two-provinces-20210501 (News24)]
*[[2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes|2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict]]
**Thirty-one people are killed and 154 others are wounded in [[Kyrgyzstan]], while 10 people are killed and 90 others are wounded in [[Tajikistan]], as the fighting between the two [[Central Asia]]n countries enters its second day. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/30/kyrgyzstan-says-31-killed-in-clashes-at-tajikistan-border?fbclid=IwAR0O5Fh7ctY5z1t3nodjWuVQ_WSGfzMyX55utbDw1PAhHLb0SwzMnGQkhzQ (Al Jazeera English)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on tourism]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on The Walt Disney Company]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[Disneyland]], the [[List of amusement park rankings#Attendance records|second most visited]] [[amusement park]] in the world, reopens with a limited capacity and guidelines for [[Social distancing measures related to the COVID-19 pandemic|social distancing]] [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|face masks]] in effect after more than one year of closure due to the pandemic. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/05/01/business/disneyland-reopens-coronavirus/ (''The Japan Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]], [[COVID-19 recession]]
***[[Sri Lanka]]'s [[gross domestic product|GDP]] [[Recession|contracts]] 3.6% in 2020, its worst [[economy of Sri Lanka|economic performance]] since [[Independence of Sri Lanka|gaining independence in 1948]]. [https://today.rtl.lu/news/world/a/1714723.html (RTL)]
*The world's longest pedestrian [[suspension bridge]], [[Arouca 516]], is completed in [[North Region, Portugal|North Region]], [[Portugal]], with local residents being the first people allowed to cross it. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/apr/29/worlds-longest-pedestrian-suspension-bridge-opens-in-portugal (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Meron stampede]]
**At least 45 people are killed and at least 150 others are injured in a [[crowd crush]] during a [[Lag BaOmer]] celebration in [[Meron, Israel|Meron]], [[Israel]]. It is the deadliest peacetime disaster in the [[history of Israel|country's history]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/dozens-said-hurt-as-stand-collapses-at-mass-lag-bomer-gathering-in-mount-meron/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Indonesia]]
*****The [[National Agency of Drug and Food Control of Indonesia|Indonesian Food and Drug Authority]] grants an emergency use authorization for the [[Sinopharm]] [[BBIBP-CorV]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]], where the vaccine will be used as part of a mutual vaccination scheme. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/indonesia-covid-19-authorise-sinopharm-vaccine-private-scheme-14719288 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports a new global record of 386,486 cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 18.76 million. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/04/30/india-covid-crisis-more-than-6point6-million-cases-in-april.html (CNBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] receives its first shipment of the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/04/30/national/moderna-vaccine-japan/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[President of South Korea|President]] [[Moon Jae-in]] receives his second dose of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20210430003400315 (Yonhap News Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Albania]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Albania]]
*****[[Albania]] approves the use of the [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-vaccine-russia-albani/albania-approves-russias-sputnik-v-covid-19-vaccine-russias-rdif-idUSL8N2MN6RA (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] administers a record 1.1 million doses of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] in the last 24 hours. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-04-29/germany-administered-record-1-1-million-covid-shots-on-wednesday (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a record 394 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 40,131. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/despite-3-week-lockdown-many-remain-on-the-move-in-turkey/2021/04/30/7e583946-a99f-11eb-a8a7-5f45ddcdf364_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
****[[Michigan]] reports its first case of the Lineage B.1.617 variant first discovered in [[India]] in a person from [[Clinton County, Michigan|Clinton County]]. [https://www.clickondetroit.com/health/good-health/2021/04/30/michigan-confirms-first-case-of-another-new-covid-variant-this-one-from-india/ (WDIV-TV)]
***[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]
****The [[White House]] announces that the [[United States]] will begin restricting travel from India beginning on May 4 due to an increase in the number of cases of the Lineage B.1.617 variant of COVID-19, which originated in India. [https://apnews.com/article/asia-pacific-lifestyle-travel-coronavirus-health-5e73dbbd0da45208af988d93c430e959 (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic on cruise ships]]
***[[Japanese authorities]] announce that they are disembarking passengers and crew from the [[MS Asuka II|MS ''Asuka II'']] [[cruise ship]] after one passenger tested positive for COVID-19. The passenger is in isolation in a cabin and is in stable condition. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/one-positive-covid-19-test-japan-luxury-cruise-ship-passengers-disembarking-2021-04-30/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***The [[World Health Organization]] grants an emergency use authorization for the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/1/who-approves-modernas-covid-19-vaccine-for-emergency-use (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Colombian peace process]]
**The leaders of the now-defunct [[Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia]] acknowledge their responsibility for tens of thousands of [[kidnapping]]s during the [[Colombian conflict]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/colombias-former-farc-accept-responsibility-kidnappings-2021-04-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[2020–2021 Thai protests]]
**Pro-[[democracy]] protest leader [[Parit Chiwarak]] is hospitalized over concerns for his health due to his continued hunger strike since March 15. The corrections department states that he was transferred to a hospital over concerns about his condition worsening to the point where he required specialized care. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/jailed-thai-protest-leader-hospitalized-after-46-day-hunger-strike-2021-04-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
**Family and friends of [[Brazil]]ian [[Workers' Party (Brazil)|Workers' Party]] activist Rodrigo Pilha, who has been imprisoned for over a month after displaying a banner calling [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] "genocidal" over poor management of the COVID-19 pandemic, say that he was beaten and [[torture]]d in prison by wardens. [https://revistaforum.com.br/noticias/exclusivo-pilha-foi-espancado-e-torturado-na-prisao/ (Forum)]
* A [[United States]] Federal court upholds a [[New Jersey]] Catholic school’s right to fire a teacher under the [[Ministerial exception|Ministerial Exception]] doctrine. The teacher was terminated from [[Saint Dominic Academy]] the day after she returned from a leave due to a motor vehicle accident. [https://religionclause.blogspot.com/2021/04/catholic-school-campus-ministers-claims.html (Religion Cause)] [https://www.catholicculture.org/news/headlines/index.cfm?storyid=50700 (Catholic World News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Palestinian legislative election]], [[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[President of the State of Palestine|President]] [[Mahmoud Abbas]] postpones the election scheduled for May 22 until further notice, after the [[Government of Israel|government]] of [[Israel]] allegedly rejected the holding of the election in [[East Jerusalem]]. Abbas says that the election cannot be held without the participation of the [[Status of Jerusalem|disputed]] area. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-04/30/c_139915915.htm (Xinhuanet)]
*[[Impeachment of Wilson Witzel]]
**In Brazil, [[List of governors of Rio de Janeiro|Governor of Rio de Janeiro]] [[Wilson Witzel]] is impeached and replaced by Vice Governor [[Cláudio Castro]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/rio-de-janeiro-governor-impeachment-confirmed-over-alleged-covid-19-related-2021-05-01/ (Reuters)]
